taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said your workload is heavy. What is happening?

Aiya, week 4 in AP already mah. Quota 80 invoices a day, but trainer said 50 for the first month. Last week stayed till 9pm three times to hit it. Rush already make more mistakes lah. Better to ramp-up quota for the first 2 months.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports working until 9pm to meet an 80-invoice daily quota that conflicts with the 50-invoice target stated by their trainer. [ROLE_CLARITY, WORKLOAD] "Last week stayed till 9pm three times to hit it."
